test_title: PYST 21: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.**

In the **__unscientific__** age or community, there are official **__repositories__** of wisdom, such as **__Egyptian preists__** and Tibetan Lamas.
solution:
The correct answer is "preists."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "preists"** in the given option contains a spelling error because the correct spelling of the word is **"priests."**
 
• **"Preists" **is a misspelling, as the correct placement of the letter** "e"** is **"priests,"** which refers to religious figures in various traditions who perform sacred rituals and provide spiritual guidance. (पुरोहित, पुजारी (धार्मिक अनुष्‍ठान करने वाला व्‍यक्ति))
 
• All the other words are spelt correctly.
 
• The correct answer is **Option 4**.

Correct sentence: *In the unscientific age or community, there are official repositories of wisdom, such as Egyptian **priests**__ and Tibetan Lamas.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Repositories: **places or containers in which something is stored in large quantities. (वह स्थान जहाँ बड़ी मात्रा में चीज़ें संग्रहित की जाती हैं, भंडार, संग्रह केंद्र)
 
• **Egyptian: **relating to Egypt or its people. (मिस्र या उसके लोगों से संबंधित)
 
• **Unscientific: **not in accordance with scientific principles or methodology. (वैज्ञानिक सिद्धांतों या पद्धति के अनुरूप नहीं)
